Container.Name: manabrew-node
Container.Overview: Headless pool of Forge-engine rooms (GraalVM native, no JVM). It dials OUT to your relay and needs no published ports. Browser players need it for anything on the Forge engine: Forge 'Play vs AI' and Forge multiplayer tables both claim an EMPTY room from this pool, one room per game. Desktop players don't need it (the desktop app runs Forge locally). For browsers to find the rooms: Format must be 'any', AI bot must be false, Room password must be empty. About 1 GB RAM for 4 rooms. Stopping the container ends games in progress; drain first with 'docker kill --signal=USR1 manabrew-node'.
Container.Requires: manabrew-relay running on the same Docker network.

Config.Name: Relay URL
Config.Description: Internal address of your relay. Container-name DNS only works on a user-defined network; otherwise use ws://UNRAID-IP:9443. No TLS needed - this never leaves the box.

Config.Name: Room name
Config.Description: Name of the pooled rooms. With Max games > 1 they become 'Name (1)', 'Name (2)'...

Config.Name: Room password
Config.Description: Leave EMPTY if browser players should use these rooms: the browser claims a room without sending a password, so a locked room fails. The relay key already keeps strangers out.

Config.Name: Format
Config.Description: Keep 'any'. Browsers only claim rooms whose format is Any; players choose the actual format per game. (Forced to any anyway when Max games > 1.)

Config.Name: Max players
Config.Description: Seats per room = you + AI opponents/friends. 4 allows a 4-player Commander pod.

Config.Name: Max games
Config.Description: Pool size: the number of browser Forge games (vs AI or multiplayer) that can run AT THE SAME TIME. Each game takes one empty room. Roughly 1 GB RAM per 4.

Config.Name: AI bot
Config.Description: Keep FALSE. True pre-seats a bot (fixed preset deck) in every room as it opens, so rooms are never empty and browsers can't claim them. Bots are spawned on demand anyway, with the deck the player picks.

Config.Name: Auto start
Config.Description: Start the game automatically when the room fills.

Config.Name: Engine backend
Config.Description: forge (original Java Forge rules, the image default) or manabrew (Rust port).

Config.Name: Shared isolate
Config.Description: Leave empty to share one engine + card DB across rooms (low RAM). Set 0 to isolate each game (more RAM, reloads the DB per game).
